methodologyNotes: Prices fetched from official vendor pricing pages via WebFetch on 2026-06-14 where accessible. OpenAI's chatgpt.com/pricing returned HTTP 403; ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo) and Pro ($200/mo) prices corroborated from Wikipedia (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ChatGPT) and cross-referenced against multiple news reports (TechCrunch, Gizmodo, CNBC). ChatGPT Team pricing ($25/seat monthly, $20/seat annual billed annually) is widely reported but official page was not accessible; recorded as per reporting. Claude pricing fetched directly from claude.com/pricing (301 redirect from anthropic.com/pricing). Google AI plan pricing could not be fetched from one.google.com (geolocated to EUR) or gemini.google.com (requires sign-in); USD prices sourced from 9to5Google tag page (June 2026 coverage, post-I/O 2026 pricing). Perplexity pricing page returned HTTP 403; Pro ($20/mo) and Max ($200/mo) prices sourced from TechCrunch article dated 2025-07-02. Microsoft Copilot Pro ($20/user/month) sourced from Wikipedia (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microsoft_Copilot); M365 Copilot Business ($18/user/month annual) fetched from microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/pricing. Mistral Vibe (formerly Le Chat) pricing fetched directly from mistral.ai/pricing. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on every plan — non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: ChatGPT
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (chatgpt.com/pricing) returned HTTP 403 on 2026-06-14. Plus ($20/mo) and Pro ($200/mo) prices sourced from Wikipedia (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ChatGPT, accessed 2026-06-14) and cross-referenced against TechCrunch and Gizmodo reporting. Team plan pricing ($25/seat/month or $20/seat/month annual) is widely reported but official page inaccessible.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Access to GPT-4o mini, limited GPT-4o, basic voice mode, web search. Usage caps apply.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Access to GPT-4o, o1, o3-mini, Advanced Voice, DALL-E image generation, higher usage limits. Launched February 2023.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Unlimited access to o1, o1 pro mode, o3, GPT-4o, and Sora. Introduced December 2024.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Billed annually at $20/seat/month; month-to-month rate is $25/seat/month. Includes GPT-4o, o1, higher message limits, admin console, shared GPTs workspace. Minimum 2 seats.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Unlimited GPT-4o, advanced security, SSO, audit logs, HIPAA-eligible BAA option, no data training by default.

vendors.name: Claude
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched directly from claude.com/pricing on 2026-06-14 (anthropic.com/pricing redirects 301 to claude.com/pricing). All plan names and prices confirmed from live page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Web and mobile chat, code generation, content creation, web search, memory, file creation, desktop extensions, Slack and Google Workspace integration.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Annual billing: $17/month ($200/year). Month-to-month: $20/month. Includes higher usage limits, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude Design, unlimited projects, Research access, multiple models, Microsoft 365/Outlook integration.

plans.name: Max 5x
plans.notes: Starting at $100/month. 5x usage limits vs Pro, higher output limits, early feature access, priority access during peak traffic.

plans.name: Max 20x
plans.notes: Starting at $200/month. 20x usage limits vs Pro, higher output limits, early feature access, priority access during peak traffic.

plans.name: Team Standard
plans.notes: Annual billing: $20/seat/month. Month-to-month: $25/seat/month. All Claude features, more usage than Pro.

plans.name: Team Premium
plans.notes: Annual billing: $100/seat/month. Month-to-month: $125/seat/month. 5x more usage than Standard seats.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Advanced security, SCIM, audit logs, compliance API, HIPAA-ready, Claude Security. Self-serve and sales-assisted options.

vendors.name: Google AI (Gemini)
vendors.provenance: Official page one.google.com/about/plans geolocated to EUR on 2026-06-14 (no USD prices available). Gemini.google.com/advanced requires sign-in. USD pricing sourced from 9to5Google tag coverage of Google AI subscriptions (June 2026, post-I/O 2026 pricing adjustments). Corroborated by TechCrunch article dated 2026-06-09 confirming AI Plus at $4.99/month.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Access to Gemini chatbot with standard limits. Included with Google account.

plans.name: Google AI Plus
plans.notes: Price dropped to $4.99/month (from $7.99) in June 2026. Includes 400 GB storage, Gemini 2x higher usage limits, video generation via Omni Flash, NotebookLM, Google Flow, Daily Brief, scheduled actions.

plans.name: Google AI Pro
plans.notes: Annual option available at $199.99/year (~$16.67/month). Includes 5 TB storage, Gemini Advanced with Gemini 2.5 Pro, Deep Research, expanded Workspace integration.

plans.name: Google AI Ultra
plans.notes: Starting at $100/month as of Google I/O 2026 (reduced from $249.99 at initial launch). 20 TB+ storage, maximum Gemini model usage, YouTube Premium, early access to Google's latest AI features.

vendors.name: Perplexity
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page perplexity.ai/pricing returned HTTP 403 on 2026-06-14. Pro ($20/month) price corroborated from TechCrunch article dated 2025-07-02 announcing the Max plan. Max ($200/month) and Enterprise Pro ($40/seat/month) prices from same TechCrunch article.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited standard searches, limited Pro searches per day, access to standard models.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Consumer tier with unlimited Pro searches, access to advanced models (GPT-4o, Claude), image generation, file upload. Annual option available at $200/year (~$16.67/month) per widely reported pricing.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: Launched July 2025. Unlimited access to Labs (spreadsheet and report generation tool), early access to Comet AI browser, priority access to latest frontier models (OpenAI o3-pro, Claude Opus 4).

plans.name: Enterprise Pro
plans.notes: $40/person/month. Business-focused plan with stronger security, data protection, team capabilities, and admin controls.

vendors.name: Microsoft Copilot
vendors.provenance: Copilot Pro ($20/user/month) price sourced from Wikipedia (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microsoft_Copilot) which cites the original launch price. M365 Copilot Business pricing fetched directly from microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/pricing on 2026-06-14 ($18/user/month annual promotional rate, $25.20/month month-to-month). Legacy M365 Copilot enterprise rate ($30/user/month) from Wikipedia citing July 2023 pricing; current enterprise pricing may differ.

plans.name: Copilot (Free)
plans.notes: Web-grounded AI chat, Microsoft Designer with limited image generation, voice interaction, mobile app. Available to all users.

plans.name: Copilot Pro
plans.notes: $20/user/month (individual consumer plan). Priority access to GPT-4 Turbo, Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps, custom Copilot GPT creation, higher-resolution image generation, early access to Copilot Labs.

plans.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Business
plans.notes: Annual billing at $18/user/month (promotional rate; regular $21/user/month). Month-to-month: $25.20/user/month. Limited to 300 users. Requires separate qualifying Microsoft 365 license. Includes AI chat with Work IQ, Copilot in Teams/Outlook/Word/PowerPoint/Excel, Copilot Studio agent creation.

plans.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales for current enterprise pricing. Historically listed at $30/user/month (July 2023 launch price). Requires Microsoft 365 E3, E5, Business Standard, or Business Premium. Full enterprise-grade security, compliance, and audit controls.

vendors.name: Mistral Vibe (Le Chat)
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched directly from mistral.ai/pricing on 2026-06-14. Product was originally launched as Le Chat and rebranded to Vibe in May 2026. Pro plan price ($14.99/month) corroborated from Wikipedia (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mistral_AI) which states Pro is $14.99/month.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Limited messages, web searches, and coding sessions. Access to latest Mistral models and image generation.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Full access to Vibe for long-running tasks and all-day coding. Expanded message limits, web searches, image generation, coding in CLI/IDE/web. Chat and email support.

plans.name: Education
plans.notes: For verified students at accredited higher institutions only. Valid for a maximum of 12 months.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $24.99/user/month. Secure, collaborative workspace for teams. Up to 30 GB storage per user, domain verification, data export.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Private deployments, custom models, agents, workflows, audit logs, SAML SSO, white-label options.

vendors.name: Grok (xAI)
vendors.provenance: Official grok.com pricing page returned HTTP 403 on 2026-06-14. x.ai/pricing returned HTTP 403. Grok is distributed via X (Twitter) Premium subscriptions. X Premium ($8/month) and Premium+ ($40/month as of February 2025 price increase) sourced from Wikipedia (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X_Premium). The $40/month price increase for Premium+ is corroborated by TechCrunch reporting (2025-02-10) found via TechCrunch tag page. SuperGrok standalone pricing not confirmed from accessible sources on this date.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Limited Grok usage available to free X users as of December 2024. Usage caps apply.

plans.name: X Premium
plans.notes: X (Twitter) Premium subscription at $8/month provides standard Grok access alongside other X features (content monetization, Media Studio, X Pro). Not a standalone Grok subscription.

plans.name: X Premium+
plans.notes: Price raised from $22/month to $40/month in February 2025 alongside Grok 3 launch. Includes no ads on X and highest Grok usage limits. Not a standalone Grok subscription.
